about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-127: the npm package x402-conformance-mcp names only dependencies a registry can serve. 1.6.0 was published with "x402-conformance-svm": "file:..", the path this repository uses to test the MCP package against its own checkout; 1.4.0 and 1.5.0 were published with ^1.4.0 and ^1.5.0 by a step that was not in the repository, and nothing here failed when 1.6.0 skipped it. `npm i x402-conformance-mcp` fails with ENOENT on the symlink (reported 11 Nov 2026 and reproduced on Node 20 and 22). This task puts the step in the repository, makes a bare `npm publish` refuse, and has CI install the package that would be published. It does not publish: the fixed release is a release task of its own.

tasks.title: x402-conformance-mcp: a registry can serve every dependency of the published package
tasks.description: ts/mcp/scripts/manifest.mjs: isRegistryRange and unservable (dependencies, optionalDependencies and peerDependencies; a version or a range passes, anything else is refused), run as the package's prepublishOnly script. ts/mcp/scripts/publish.mjs (`npm run release`): packs the package, sets x402-conformance-svm to ^ the version in ts/package.json in the packed copy, refuses when that core version is not on the registry, publishes the copy's tarball, reads the dependencies back from the registry and runs verify-install on the published name; `--stage DIR` writes the copy and its tarball and publishes nothing; the working tree is not changed. ts/mcp/scripts/verify-install.mjs: an empty folder, npm init, npm install of the given specs, then the manifest, the command's --version, the import, initialize over stdio, and the ai-sdk and langchain entry points with the peer versions the release was tested with. ts/mcp/test/package.test.ts. CI's mcp job runs the install from the packed tarballs. Docs: CHANGELOG, docs/RELEASES.md; README and docs/INTERDEPENDENCY.md are regenerated.

criteria.statement: A version or a range is a dependency a registry can serve and a path, a link, a workspace, a URL or a tag is not; npm publish stops at the prepublishOnly guard while a dependency is file:..; the released copy names ^ the core version and the checkout's package.json is left as it was

verifier.cmd: o=$(mktemp) && { cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && cd mcp && npm ci --silent && npm run build --silent && node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^npm package: ' dist/test/package.test.js; } > "$o" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$o"; test "$rc" = 0 && node -e 'const[f,p,k]=process.argv.slice(1),re=new RegExp(p),min=+(k||1);let n=0,bad=0,cur=0;const fin=()=>{n+=cur;cur=0};for(const l of require("fs").readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n")){const m=/^ *(not )?ok \d+ - (.*)$/.exec(l);if(m){fin();if(m[1])bad++;else if(!/ # (SKIP|TODO)\b/.test(m[2])&&re.test(m[2]))cur=1;continue}if(/^ *type: .suite.$/.test(l))cur=0}fin();console.log("guard: "+n+" passing test(s) named /"+p+"/ (need "+min+"), "+bad+" not ok");process.exit(n>=min&&!bad?0:1)' "$o" '^npm package: ' 5

criteria.statement: The package as it would be published installs from its tarball in an empty folder beside the core tarball, and loads: the manifest names only versions and ranges, the command prints its version, the import works, the server answers initialize on stdio, and the ai-sdk and langchain entry points return tools

verifier.cmd: T=$(mktemp -d) && cd ts && npm ci --silent && npm pack --silent --pack-destination "$T" > /dev/null && cd mcp && npm ci --silent && node scripts/publish.mjs --stage "$T/mcp" && node scripts/verify-install.mjs "$T"/x402-conformance-svm-*.tgz "$T"/mcp/x402-conformance-mcp-*.tgz

criteria.statement: npm publish in ts/mcp exits non-zero and names the dependency a registry cannot serve, before anything is packed or sent

verifier.cmd: cd ts/mcp && out=$(npm publish --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?; echo "$out"; test "$rc" != 0 && echo "$out" | grep -q 'a registry cannot serve these dependencies' && echo "$out" | grep -q 'dependencies.x402-conformance-svm'

criteria.statement: CI's mcp job installs the staged package from its tarball
The changelog names the task and the two ways to install until a fixed release is out
docs/RELEASES.md says how the MCP package is published and that 1.6.0 cannot be installed
The docs and the interdependency map agree with the tree (no drift)
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.
Never publish from this task: no npm publish outside --dry-run or a loopback registry, no tag, no dist-tag change. The fixed release is its own task.
